dataset.name: OpenSAR Insight Sentinel-1 GRD filtered dataset
dataset.license: Composite (MIT OpenSARInsight / AGPL-3.0 Ultralytics / Copernicus Open Access)

evaluation_held_out_test.notes: Evaluated strictly on held-out OpenSAR test split (100 images, 257 vessels).

limitations: Metrics reflect performance on the OpenSAR Insight held-out test split under standard high-contrast Sentinel-1 GRD processing. Generalization gap is expected in high-clutter sea states or variable incidence angles. Detections must be interpreted as probabilistic operational estimates, not navigational ground truth.
